page.overview:
Who is Professor Grube?

Professor Grube is a character in the G.I. Joe A Real American Hero coloring books from Golden (Western Publishing).

Professor Grube is a scientist working to develop a propulsion system for the Crusader so the Joes can build a Moon Base.

She's working out of a G.I. Joe base in the desert, protected by Rock 'n Roll and his team.

Destro, Darklon and their Iron Grenadier forces attack and manage to capture Professor Grube.
